_comment: Dated events and the day-by-day plan (participants only). Times are Paris time, HH:MM. 活动与每日安排（每日安排只给学员）；时间为巴黎时间。

events.titleZh: Julia Rajacic 与《The Ecology of Movement》五位艺术家对谈

days.plan: If already in Paris, choose one open institution: HCB, LE BAL or Quai. Leave time for the optional 17:00–18:00 FotoFilmic meet & greet at Le Sancerre, 87 Rue des Archives.
days.planZh: 如果已经在巴黎，挑一家开放的机构：HCB、LE BAL 或 Quai。为 17:00–18:00 在 Le Sancerre（87 Rue des Archives）举行的可选 FotoFilmic 见面会留出时间。

days.plan: Workshop first. Most museums/galleries are closed. Do not make a long cross-city plan after class.
days.planZh: 以工作坊为先。大多数博物馆和画廊闭馆。下课后不要安排横穿城市的长线。

days.plan: Workshop and FotoFilmic opening at 18:00. A nearby short stop only if the actual class schedule permits.
days.planZh: 工作坊，以及 18:00 的 FotoFilmic 开幕式。只有实际课程安排允许时，才在附近短暂停留一站。

days.plan: Final workshop day and public holiday. HCB is the strongest nearby institutional option; confirm access before relying on smaller galleries. BnF is closed.
days.planZh: 工作坊最后一天，也是公共假日。HCB 是附近最值得去的机构；去小画廊之前先确认能否入场。BnF 闭馆。

days.plan: Best gallery-walk day: Marais route, plus an optional opening. MEP stays open to 22:00.
days.planZh: 最适合逛画廊的一天：走玛黑路线，再加一场可选的开幕活动。MEP 开放到 22:00。

days.plan: Choose one museum or north-city route, then return for FotoFilmic JRNL at 18:00.
days.planZh: 选一座博物馆或北城路线，然后回来参加 18:00 的 FotoFilmic JRNL 活动。

days.plan: A half-day route; leave time for FotoFilmic closing at 18:00. LE BAL book signings are an alternative, not another obligation.
days.planZh: 走半天路线；为 18:00 的 FotoFilmic 闭幕留出时间。LE BAL 的签售会可作为替代选择，不是额外的任务。

days.plan: Institutions and riverbank route if departure permits; BnF opens at 13:00. Most galleries are shut. Check your own departure time; staff deinstallation duties are not participant requirements.
days.planZh: 如果离开的时间允许，可去各机构并走河岸路线；BnF 13:00 开门。大多数画廊不开门。请确认你自己的离开时间；工作人员的撤展工作不是学员的义务。
